summary.text: Charlie Hatcher is a veterinarian and dairy farmer who served as Tennessee State Veterinarian and then, from 2019 to 2025, as Tennessee Commissioner of Agriculture. He defeated incumbent Rep. Andy Ogles in the August 6, 2026 Republican primary and is the Republican nominee for the 5th District.

paragraphs.text: A fifth-generation Tennessee farmer; his Ballotpedia biography says he operated the family's seventh-generation dairy farm in College Grove, Tennessee, established in 1847.
Holds a bachelor's degree in animal science from Middle Tennessee State University and a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
Has more than 20 years in veterinary practice, specializing in livestock; his campaign website says he started eight businesses, including Hatcher Family Dairy, and describes him as an author.
Served as Tennessee State Veterinarian for about a decade before being appointed Commissioner of Agriculture by Gov. Bill Lee; he took office January 1, 2019, and left September 30, 2025.

Held national leadership roles, including past president of the American Association of Bovine Practitioners, the National Assembly of State Animal Health Officials, the United States Animal Health Association and the Southern Association of State Departments of Agriculture, and chaired the National Association of State Departments of Agriculture's Animal Agriculture Committee.
Has served on the University of Tennessee Board of Trustees and the Tennessee Board of Regents.

Launched his 5th District campaign on November 4, 2025, at Battle Mountain Farm in College Grove, and won the Republican primary over incumbent Andy Ogles on August 6, 2026, 53.3 percent to 46.7 percent.
